METHOD NAME=byte_swap CODE=local z_word_t byte_swap(z_word_t word) {\n#  if W == 8\n    return\n        (word & 0xff00000000000000) >> 56 |\n        (word & 0xff000000000000) >> 40 |\n        (word & 0xff0000000000) >> 24 |\n        (word & 0xff00000000) >> 8 |\n        (word & 0xff000000) << 8 |\n        (word & 0xff0000) << 24 |\n        (word & 0xff00) << 40 |\n        (word & 0xff) << 56;\n#  else   /* W == 4 */\n    return\n        (word & 0xff000000) >> 24 |\n        (word & 0xff0000) >> 8 |\n        (word & 0xff00) << 8 |\n        (word & 0xff) << 24;\n#  endif\n} FULL_NAME=byte_swap SIGNATURE=local(z_word_t) ORDER=1

  METHOD_PARAMETER_OUT NAME=word CODE=z_word_t word TYPE_FULL_NAME=z_word_t ORDER=1
